goal: Stop expanding keys below range_start on descriptor import, speeding up imports and fixing key ownership
Ensure keys below range_start are not falsely treated as owned before a wallet restart
Prevent severe hangs when importing descriptors configured with very high range start indices
agreement: Verified by testing fix on regtest, confirming reload consistency and import speedup (fametrano)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because keys below range_start were falsely marked owned until restart, losing ownership on reload
Avoids derivation hangs of up to 2^31 keys and massively speeds up imports with high range offsets
Prevents redundant key re-expansions whenever reloading an active descriptor wallet
